title: Guarded Canary V1 Clearance Gate Checkpoint
claim: FP-MCP-315 recorded and validated a fresh scoped approval for the FP-MCP-295 canary tuple, then the narrowed guarded executor successfully performed the V1 clearance preview/create gate without consuming approval, contacting the runner start endpoint, starting OpenCode, creating scoped enablement, or running the canary.
summary: The live narrowed MCP surface exposed only the guarded sequencer and enforced executor for guarded continuation. A fresh FP-MCP-315 approval was recorded, committed at 20efcb7, validated as usable for execution scope, and then used by forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate. The executor internally previewed the clearance gate and replaced the expired local clearance with CLEARANCE-20260704T175836214Z-8a2a72ac, expiring at 2026-07-04T18:03:36.214Z, while stopping before enablement or runner start.
caveats: The created clearance was intentionally short-lived and should now be treated as expired for future work.
The executor result reported clearanceCreated=false and clearanceMutated=true because an expired local clearance file already existed at .local/forgepilot/execution-clearance.json and was replaced.
FP-MCP-315 did not prove scoped enablement creation, final preflight, runner start, OpenCode start, approval consumption, or canary execution.
boundaries: No runner start endpoint was contacted.
The guarded canary did not run.
This checkpoint records evidence only and does not authorize execution.
observedResult: FP-MCP-315 recorded and validated a fresh scoped approval for the FP-MCP-295 canary tuple, then the narrowed guarded executor successfully performed the V1 clearance preview/create gate without consuming approval, contacting the runner start endpoint, starting OpenCode, creating scoped enablement, or running the canary.
